pairs.difference: A has a soft satin finish across the whistle's broad face. B has a nearly textureless face with bright, continuous glossy edging around the face and circular side.
pairs.fix: Give the orange plastic a soft satin surface with faint fine texture; keep narrow highlights only along a few edges.

pairs.difference: A's brass tube has crisp reflective streaks, contrasting with the softer red cord. B's brass has broader, duller reflections, while the cord wrapping has conspicuous repeated braided ridges.
pairs.fix: Add crisp, narrow reflections to the brass tubing. Make the red cord matte with quieter, finer twisted strands.

pairs.difference: Both cups show smooth glazed ceramic, reflective blue rims and glossy tea. A's sharper reflections and B's softer reflections provide insufficient evidence of a finish mismatch.
A's cloth has quiet surface texture and its wicker has broad, clean strands. B's cloth shows conspicuous woven grain, and its wicker carries dense fine striations across nearly every strip.
pairs.fix: Make the cloth's weave barely visible at card size. Use smooth wicker strips with sparse, subtle lengthwise grain.

pairs.difference: A's barrel staves carry soft, flowing wood grain. B's staves show numerous straight, sharply incised vertical marks; its upper metal hoop also has a stronger concentrated shine.
pairs.fix: Use shallow, softly varying wood grain instead of repeated carved scratches. Give the hoops restrained satin reflections.

pairs.difference: A separates reflective chrome bumpers and mirrors, finely ribbed headlamp glass and glossy painted panels. B's bumper, wheel hubs and headlamp surrounds have similarly soft plastic-looking finishes, and the lamp faces lose the fine ribbing.
pairs.fix: Give the bumper and lamp surrounds crisp silver reflections, add fine ribs inside the headlamp glass, and keep the tires matte.

pairs.difference: A's tent panels have visible fine fabric grain, with textured reinforcement and rope. B's broad panels and entrance flaps are almost uniformly smooth, with rounded glossy-looking seam edges.
pairs.fix: Add quiet fine canvas grain across the panels and reinforcement strips. Keep the fabric matte and the seam highlights soft.

pairs.difference: A's pot contrasts a smooth bright rim with localized coarse soot stippling below. B spreads fine metallic grain over most of the bowl and adds prominent decorative grain to the wooden support.
pairs.fix: Keep the pot's upper metal smooth, concentrate irregular soot speckles near its underside, and soften the support's wood grain.

pattern: Generated finishes often spread one smooth sheen or one uniform texture across large regions, losing the real cards' localized material contrasts.
